pr.title: feat(dcp): TP-102 red-lane taxonomy instance + detector schema evolution
pr.body:
## Summary
- Evolves `schemas/dcp/dcp_red_lane_taxonomy.schema.json`: lane items gain optional `detectors[]` array (type enum: path_pattern|text_pattern|builtin|manual) and `enforcement` field. Schema minor version bump, REPO_VALIDATED provenance citing red_lane_rules.py.
- Creates `config/dcp/red_lane_taxonomy.json`: 11 existing lanes + 4 new repo-derived lanes (DOPETASK-EXECUTION, FORBIDDEN-NETWORK-CALL, LIVE-WRITE-CREEP, STALE-PROOF) with detectors per design B.2/B.4. PROOF-CONTRACT-SCHEMA-MUTATION stays hard_block covering schemas/dcp/** and config/dcp/**.
- Tightens gh api pattern scope to executable contexts only (A7c) — documented as deliberate, exempt from TP-103 equivalence corpus.
- Adds `tests/dcp/test_taxonomy_invariants.py`: every hard_block lane has a non-manual detector or manual justification; every Rule has a lane_id after TP-103 coupling (structural invariant pre-wired).
- Ships hand-authored `proof/DMX-DCP-TOOLING-102/APPROVAL.json` per design B.6.

## Scope
Schema evolution (minor bump), new runtime instance, CI invariant tests, proof. No scanner behavior change — loader not wired until TP-103.

## NOT_RUN
Scanner behavioral tests (loader not wired yet), live enforcement, full DCP suite against new lanes.

steps.task: Preflight repo identity, branch, marker, dirty state. Read the current dcp_red_lane_taxonomy.schema.json and the test fixture (tests/dcp/fixtures/ or similar) to establish baseline lane count, field shapes, and the PROOF-CONTRACT-SCHEMA-MUTATION gate value. Read red_lane_rules.py to identify REPO_VALIDATED detector patterns for each lane.
validation: Baseline lane count and PROOF-CONTRACT-SCHEMA-MUTATION gate value recorded in PROOF.json.
red_lane_rules.py patterns that will back REPO_VALIDATED provenance are identified and cited.

steps.task: Evolve schemas/dcp/dcp_red_lane_taxonomy.schema.json (minor bump): add optional detectors[] array to lane item shape. Each detector object: type (enum: path_pattern|text_pattern|builtin|manual, required), patterns (array of strings, present for path_pattern/text_pattern), path_scope (optional string regex for text_pattern), name (string, present for builtin). Add optional enforcement field to lane items (enum: deterministic|llm_advisory|human). All additions are optional (additive, backward-compatible). Schema remains additionalProperties:false at lane item level. Per design B.2.
validation: Existing taxonomy test fixtures still validate against the evolved schema (additive change preserves backward compat).
detector type enum is exactly: path_pattern, text_pattern, builtin, manual.
enforcement enum is exactly: deterministic, llm_advisory, human.
Schema changes are additive only — no required fields removed or changed.

steps.task: Create config/dcp/red_lane_taxonomy.json: the runtime taxonomy instance. Include all 11 existing lanes (verified from red_lane_rules.py baseline) plus 4 new repo-derived lanes: DOPETASK-EXECUTION, FORBIDDEN-NETWORK-CALL, LIVE-WRITE-CREEP, STALE-PROOF. For each lane add detectors per design B.2/B.4: BRANCH-PROTECTION-MUTATION (text: gh api branch/rulesets patterns, text: gh ruleset); CODEOWNERS-MUTATION (path: CODEOWNERS$); PULL-REQUEST-TARGET-UNTRUSTED-CHECKOUT (text: pull_request_target, path_scope workflows); PROOF-CONTRACT-SCHEMA-MUTATION (path: ^schemas/dcp/, ^config/dcp/ — gate MUST be hard_block); SECRETS-IN-ARGV-CACHE-LOGS (text: token-shaped regex); AGENT-APPROVED-MERGE-WITHOUT-SUPERVISOR (builtin: merge_seam_without_approval); WORKFLOW-PERMISSION-ESCALATION (path: workflow block + text: permissions elevation, marked partial — documented); AI-AGENT-AUTHORITY-COLLAPSE (manual — advisory only). gh api text pattern scoped to executable path_scope (py/sh/yml/yaml extensions) per A7c — add comment: DELIBERATE_CHANGE_EXEMPT_FROM_TP103_EQUIVALENCE_CORPUS. Provenance: REPO_VALIDATED citing red_lane_rules.py for derived patterns; MANUAL with justification for manual-only lanes.
validation: PROOF-CONTRACT-SCHEMA-MUTATION lane has gate=hard_block — verified programmatically.
All 15 lanes (11 existing + 4 new) are present.
gh api pattern has path_scope restricting to executable file extensions.
LIVE-WRITE-CREEP lane references LIVE_WRITE_READY undefined/blocking posture.

steps.task: Create tests/dcp/test_taxonomy_invariants.py: (1) load config/dcp/red_lane_taxonomy.json and validate against schema, (2) assert every lane with gate=hard_block has at least one detector with type != manual OR has a documented manual justification field, (3) assert PROOF-CONTRACT-SCHEMA-MUTATION has gate=hard_block, (4) assert the 4 new lanes are present (DOPETASK-EXECUTION, FORBIDDEN-NETWORK-CALL, LIVE-WRITE-CREEP, STALE-PROOF), (5) assert no scanner behavior change has occurred yet (load_taxonomy does not exist yet — assert ImportError or absence gracefully).
validation: Test for hard_block lanes having non-manual detectors or manual justification passes.
